title: Plan a Visit — Baker Road Baptist Church
metaDescription: Exactly what happens on a Sunday morning at Baker Road Baptist Church in Baytown: where to park, when to arrive, where the kids go, and what the service is like.
headline: Here is exactly what will happen.
intro: Walking into a church you have never been to is genuinely hard. So rather than tell you how friendly we are, here is the whole morning, start to finish.

sections.heading: 900 W. Baker Rd
sections.body: Park anywhere in the lot off Baker Road. Come in through the main doors under the portico. There is no wrong door and no reserved parking.

sections.heading: Aim for 10:05
sections.body: Ten minutes before the 10:15 service is plenty. If you would rather start smaller, come at 9:00 for Sunday School and ask at the door which class fits you.

sections.heading: Where the kids go
sections.body: Classes are divided by age, from bed babies through grade 5, with a separate youth class for grades 6 through 12. Childcare is available during worship. You are also welcome to keep your kids with you in the service, and nobody will look sideways at a noisy toddler.

sections.heading: A typical Sunday
sections.body: The service runs about ninety minutes and follows the same shape most weeks.
sections.note: Order and timing shift a little week to week. Bring a Bible if you own one, and if you do not, there are Bibles in the pews.

items.title: Prayer and offering
items.body: Boxes by the exits, no plate passed to you

sections.heading: Still have a question?
sections.body: Call the church office during the week and a real person will answer. Pastor Marvin is glad to meet with anyone who wants to talk before they ever set foot in a service.
